bernsteinReplacement.strategy: Runtime de Casteljau recurrence at existing OCCT Gauss points; all degrees 1..25 and rules 1..24 retained.

strtodValidation.reference: Pinned OCCT Strtod plus JavaScript nearest-double conversion for decimal inputs

ioPruning.strategy: Memory-stream STEP input, programmatic resource defaults, no native diagnostic printer, lazy compatibility stream, and Emscripten FILESYSTEM=0. Checks, exceptions and status flags retained.

validation.reference: Compiled pinned registration bodies, original StepType switch and original complex recognizer/reverse recipes

keywordReplacement.strategy: Immutable sorted full-name/alias tables, lazy canonical-name cache, and compact exact complex-entity rules over sorted spelling ranks. Original last-alias-binding and first-complex-match behavior retained.
